note: The stream keys the engine is CONFIGURED to produce, as streamKeyFor() builds them. The silence watchdog (scripts/engine/watchdog.mjs) needs this list in plain Node — it cannot import tiers.ts — and it must include streams that have produced NOTHING, which is exactly the tier-A failure mode it exists to catch (a stream with no rows is invisible to any DB-derived list). tests/silence.test.ts asserts this file matches tierStreams() exactly, so it cannot drift silently.
